name: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Take a pinch

params.text: yields a pinch of whatever seasoning you name

powers.text: It yields a pinch of whatever seasoning you name. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: 10 charges: a pinch of any seasoning you like.
text: This belt pouch appears empty and has 10 charges. While holding the pouch, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 of its charges, speak the name of any nonmagical food seasoning (such as salt, pepper, saffron or cilantro) and remove a pinch of the desired seasoning from the pouch. A pinch is enough to season a single meal. The pouch regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn.
